definitions.explanation: A large metal cooking pot, traditionally made of iron, used for cooking rice and other dishes.

examples.english: Cook rice in an iron pot.
In the old days, every house had a large iron pot.

examples.japanese: ⟦おばあちゃん→おばあちゃん：10968_obaachan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{釜|かま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炊|た}いた→炊く：02127_taku⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Grandma still says rice cooked in an iron pot tastes the best.

notes:
USAGE:
- In modern Japan the ⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧ (rice cooker) has largely replaced the traditional {釜|かま}, though the cooker's inner pot is still called {内釜|うちがま}.
- In compounds, {釜|かま} is also the heating unit of a bath or boiler: ⟦{風呂釜|ふろがま}→風呂釜：28259_furogama⟧ (bath heater).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{釜|かま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧: to cook rice in a traditional pot
- ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{釜|かま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飯|めし}→飯：03805_meshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧: to have lived and worked side by side (literally, to eat rice from the same pot)

WRITING:
- {釜|かま}: iron pot for cooking
- ⟦{窯|かま}→窯：13764_kama⟧: kiln for pottery or bricks (same reading, different kanji)
